value.rationale: The source motivates this counterexample by hardware implementability and lack of a minimum inter-event time. The exact laws quantify the resource cost rather than merely restating failure of a positive lower bound: intervals shrink harmonically, event times grow logarithmically, and event count has logarithmic rate one. The parameter-independent leading interval coefficient is a useful and non-obvious consequence.
